context.note: Phones find each other only while is open on both of them. Locking your phone or closing the app counts as leaving.
Nothing you share in is sent to us or to any server. It goes only between phones that are close together.

p.ph: What you share with a match fades 30 minutes after you part, unless you both tap Stay connected.

step.cmd: On the Me tab, tap the gear icon to open Settings.
Open the Match screen: on the Nearby tab, tap Open on the person's card.
